newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks up 2.04 pct on economic recovery hope.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks up 2.04 pct on economic recovery hope.

text.p: The composite stock index shot up by 14.74 points, or 2.04 percent, to 738.09 in Wednesday's afternoon trading on investor hopes that the economy would improve, brokers said.
Brokers said the strengthening yen and a rise in export prices rekindled hopes of an economic turnaround.
Falling interest rates and a high level of customers deposit at 3.3 trillion won also boosted investors' sentiment.
The benchmark three-year corporate yields hit 11.98 percent, the lowest level in three and half months.

"Investors expected a liquidity-driven market with sharply falling interest rates," said Casey Choe of Union Bank of Switzerlan. "Securities houses, banks and construction companies will benefit from the rate decline."
